## Featured projects

📚 Kaman AI Translator
A PyQt6 desktop studio that translates whole PDF and EPUB books into fluent academic Persian — and back into English — one page at a time or an entire book unattended. Per-book structure templates keep terminology consistent, a QC review loop catches meaning drift, and API keys are encrypted with Windows DPAPI. 303 offline tests, Windows release v3.0.0.
Python, PyQt6, Gemini / OpenAI-compatible APIs, SSE, DPAPI, PDF, EPUB
Case study: https://mhkaman.com/en/projects/kaman-ai-translator/
Source code: https://github.com/Mohammad-Hasan-Kaman/kaman-ai-translator

🩺 Agent Stream Doctor
A zero-dependency Python CLI that reads raw SSE chat-completion captures and explains exactly why an LLM stream returned nothing — reasoning-only responses, missing finish_reason, malformed SSE framing, truncated tool calls. Twelve named checks, an explainable report, JSON output for CI, usable as a library. Release v0.2.0.
Python, SSE, OpenAI-compatible APIs, CLI, JSON output
Case study: https://mhkaman.com/en/projects/agent-stream-doctor/
Source code: https://github.com/Mohammad-Hasan-Kaman/agent-stream-doctor

🧠 AI Counseling Widget
An AI intake system for counselling centres, shipped as a Persian RTL chat widget. The assistant talks to every visitor, runs the GHQ-28 wellbeing screening, extracts clinical concepts from free text and matches the person to the right consultant. Multi-tenant API keys and admin panel, embedded with a single script tag — no hosted LLM, no per-message cost. Live at kahaai.ir.
FastAPI, SQLite, GHQ-28 screening, concept extraction, matching engine, RTL UI
Case study: https://mhkaman.com/en/projects/ai-counseling-widget/
Source code: https://github.com/Mohammad-Hasan-Kaman/ai-counseling-widget
Live: https://kahaai.ir

💬 AI Counseling Bot
The same clinical intake intelligence as a Bale messenger bot: a 12-state guided conversation, the GHQ-28 wellbeing screen, and a SpiralMatchEngine that re-weights itself from panel feedback. Admins run statistics, Excel import/export, broadcasts and engine training from inside the chat. No external API, no cloud LLM. Release v1.0.0.
Python, Bale Messenger API, GHQ-28 screening, matching engine, SQLite
Case study: https://mhkaman.com/en/projects/ai-counseling-bot/
Source code: https://github.com/Mohammad-Hasan-Kaman/ai-counseling-bot
Live: https://kahaai.ir

🗂️ Kaman Portfolio
This very site: a trilingual (EN/FA/AR) Django portfolio where every page is editable from the Django admin, with a trilingual PDF CV generator that shapes RTL text with HarfBuzz, privacy-friendly server-side analytics, and sitemap, robots.txt and llms.txt built in. Live at mhkaman.com.
Django, SQLite, fpdf2, HarfBuzz shaping, nginx, gunicorn
Case study: https://mhkaman.com/en/projects/kaman-portfolio/
Source code: https://github.com/Mohammad-Hasan-Kaman/kaman-portfolio
Live: https://mhkaman.com

🔐 Kaman Messenger
A real-time encrypted messenger built completely from scratch: raw TCP sockets, Fernet (AES) traffic encryption, bcrypt authentication, rate limiting and SQLite storage, with a CustomTkinter GUI. Ships as a client and a server executable.
Python, TCP Sockets, Fernet/AES, bcrypt, SQLite, CustomTkinter
Case study: https://mhkaman.com/en/projects/kaman-messenger/
Source code: https://github.com/Mohammad-Hasan-Kaman/kaman-messenger

## More projects

🌐 Dr-Kaman Site
A multimedia archive for Dr. Mohammad Reza Kaman — podcasts, videos, books and articles with cross-media search, topic categories, a homepage slider and SEO endpoints for crawlers. Django behind nginx and gunicorn on a Linux VPS. Live at drkaman.ir.
Django, SQLite, nginx, gunicorn, Linux VPS, JavaScript
Case study: https://mhkaman.com/en/projects/dr-kaman-site/

🎓 Planikaa Portal
A Django educational platform for exam and competition analysis with visual dashboards, an educational blog, a review and feedback system, Jalali (Persian) calendar support and django-allauth accounts.
Django, SQLite, Chart.js, Jalali calendar, django-allauth
Case study: https://mhkaman.com/en/projects/planikaa-portal/
Source code: https://github.com/Mohammad-Hasan-Kaman/planikaa-portal

💬 Kaman AI Chat
A C# WinForms chat assistant that talks to DeepSeek models through the OpenModel API and speaks the reply with the Windows built-in text-to-speech engine. The API key is resolved at runtime from an environment variable, app.config or a per-user settings file — never baked into the source. Single dependency-free .exe.
C#, .NET Framework 4.8, WinForms, OpenModel API, System.Speech
Case study: https://mhkaman.com/en/projects/kaman-ai-chat/
Source code: https://github.com/Mohammad-Hasan-Kaman/kaman-ai-chat

🕌 Quran Group Bot
A serverless Bale bot that runs a 30-person weekly Quran juz reading circle — Cloudflare Workers and KV with cron-scheduled posts, rotating juz assignment and a weekly hadith. No server, no hosting bill.
Bale Messenger, Cloudflare Workers, KV, JavaScript, Cron
Case study: https://mhkaman.com/en/projects/quran-group-bot/
Source code: https://github.com/Mohammad-Hasan-Kaman/quran-group-bot

⬇️ YouTube Downloader
A Windows YouTube downloader built on yt-dlp with a Persian dark-mode GUI, three live progress bars, video and audio format selection, and browser-cookie support for age-restricted or private links.
Python, CustomTkinter, yt-dlp, RTL UI
Case study: https://mhkaman.com/en/projects/youtube-downloader/
Source code: https://github.com/Mohammad-Hasan-Kaman/youtube-downloader

🧭 Kaman Web Browser
A lightweight multi-tab Windows browser on Microsoft Edge WebView2 (Chromium) with smart routing that decides whether what you typed is a URL or a search query, plus bookmarks and session handling.
C#, .NET, WebView2, Chromium
Case study: https://mhkaman.com/en/projects/kaman-web-browser/
Source code: https://github.com/Mohammad-Hasan-Kaman/kaman-web-browser

## Articles

 Building a Persian-first desktop translator for PDF and EPUB books — chunking, rolling context, and a per-book structure template
Translating a 300-page book in a chat window fails in predictable ways: the model summarizes instead of translating, terminology drifts between chapters, running headers become translated garbage, and one crash loses an hour of work. This is a Windows desktop app that fixes each of those with local, readable code — paragraph-aware chunking, a rolling context tail, per-book structure templates, a DPAPI-encrypted key, and a job store that saves every finished page.
Read: https://mhkaman.com/en/articles/building-a-persian-first-desktop-translator-for-pdf-and-epub-books/

 Shipping a counseling bot on Bale: GHQ-28 screening, self-learning matching and 12 conversation states
How a messenger bot can run a full clinical intake end to end — a 12-state conversation handler, the GHQ-28 wellbeing screen, a matching engine that re-weights itself from panel feedback, an availability crawler and a full admin panel inside the chat itself. Built on the Telegram-compatible Bale API.
Read: https://mhkaman.com/en/articles/shipping-a-counseling-bot-on-bale-with-ghq-28-screening-and-self-learning-matching/

 Building an AI counseling widget that matches visitors to the right counselor — without a hosted LLM
A drop-in Persian RTL chat widget that runs a structured intake, administers the GHQ-28 wellbeing screen, extracts clinical concepts from free text and ranks counselors — with every clinic's own API key, admin panel and intake flow. No hosted model, no per-message cost, nothing leaving the server.
Read: https://mhkaman.com/en/articles/building-an-ai-counseling-widget-that-matches-visitors-to-counselors/

 Why is my LLM stream empty? A field guide to broken SSE responses
Reasoning-only replies, missing finish_reason, malformed SSE frames — the four most common reasons a streaming LLM call returns nothing, and how to diagnose each one.
Read: https://mhkaman.com/en/articles/why-is-my-llm-stream-empty/

## Professional Projects

Kaman AI Translator — Whole-Book PDF & EPUB Translation — 2024 — 2026 — Freelance
Commercial Python desktop application that translates academic and technical PDF/EPUB books into fluent Persian and back into English. Smart paragraph-level chunking with a rolling context tail, a per-book structure template for headings and recurring labels, a QC review loop, per-page job store with pause/resume across restarts, DPAPI-encrypted API keys and 303 offline tests. Windows executable, release v3.0.0.

Agent Stream Doctor — LLM Streaming Diagnostics — 2025 — 2026 — Open Source
Zero-dependency Python toolkit that diagnoses why an LLM stream returns nothing: reasoning-only responses, missing finish_reason, malformed SSE framing and truncated tool calls. Twelve named checks, a tolerant parser that turns every malformed deviation into a finding instead of an exception, JSON output for CI and a clean library API. Release v0.2.0.

AI Counseling Platform — Widget & Bale Bot — 2024 — Freelance
Built an AI intake system for a counselling centre: a conversational Persian RTL widget and a Bale messenger bot, both running a 12-state guided interview, the GHQ-28 wellbeing screening, clinical concept extraction and a self-learning consultant-matching engine. Fully local — no hosted LLM, no per-message cost, no visitor data leaving the server. Running in production at kahaai.ir.

Educational Website & CMS (Django) — 2023 — 2024 — Client Project
Django-based CMS platform with secure user authentication, SQLite storage, multi-format media management (video/audio playback) and dynamic categorized content delivery, deployed with nginx and gunicorn on a Linux VPS.

Planikaa Portal — Educational Platform (Django) — 2023 — Client Project
Educational web platform built with Django: exam and competition analysis with visual dashboards, an educational blog, a review and feedback system, django-allauth accounts and Jalali (Persian) calendar support. SQLite is the only database backend the project is configured for.

KamanBrowser — Desktop Web Browser — 2022 — 2023 — Personal Project
Modern desktop web browser built with C# and Windows Forms on Edge WebView2 (Chromium): tab management, bookmarks, custom UI components and smooth navigation with a minimal memory footprint.
